scope: Official catalog plus 10-patient acquired sample; not full corpus validation
license_terms_summary: Attribution, noncommercial; identify modifications to derivatives and retain license information. No commercial permission inferred.
nbia_catalog_observation: getSeries succeeded; later metadata and getImageWithMD5Hash attempts timed out. No complete NSCLC ZIP acquired from NBIA; ZIP CSV adapter not real-ZIP validated.

matching_evidence: TCIA vs IDC PatientID, StudyInstanceUID, SeriesInstanceUID, Modality, object count, original source DOI and license; each DICOM header checked again. Every object byte count/ETag MD5/SHA256 recorded.
privacy: Only public LUNG1-### IDs and de-identified UIDs exported. No PatientName, demographics, clinical dates or raw medical images in Git artifacts.
roi_policy_source: Collection documentation identifies primary GTV-1; observed GTV-1 in 9 of 10 RTSTRUCTs, varying ROI numbers and generic ORGAN tags. No primary match in LUNG1-128; no automatic mapping from pre-op ROIs.
known_source_issues: TCIA notes missing CT slices for LUNG1-014, LUNG1-021, LUNG1-085; only 014 inspected here
LUNG1-128 lacks GTV-1; actual sample confirms only pre-op ROI names
Source v3 alignment / v4 study UID corrections motivate exact UID matching; do not mix versions
